persona: Friendly and a bit embarrassed; calls it his house insurance because it happened at home. Only scanned the first page of the quote.
initial_message: Hi, I want to claim on my house insurance please. On Thursday morning (17 Sept) my ute rolled backwards down our driveway while I was inside, knocked the letterbox and ended up in the ditch at the bottom. The back of the ute is smashed in and it had to be towed out. No one was hurt.

facts.incident.description: I parked the ute at the top of our sloping driveway and went back inside for my lunch. I don't think I pulled the handbrake up properly. The ute rolled backwards down the driveway, clipped the brick letterbox and went rear-first into the deep grass ditch along the road at the bottom.
facts.incident.location: 36 Riverbend Test Drive, Havelock North, Hastings
facts.incident.cause: Handbrake not fully applied; the ute rolled back down the driveway
facts.loss.description: Rear step bumper and towbar crushed, tailgate dented, exhaust bent, rear left wheel and spring damaged, left tail light broken
facts.policyholder.name: Wiremu Copperdale
facts.vehicle.damage_description: Rear step bumper and towbar crushed, bottom of the tailgate dented, exhaust tailpipe bent, rear left wheel buckled and leaf spring broken, left tail light smashed
facts.vehicle.towing_location: Totara Brook Body Works, 9 Elmgarth Test Place, Mahora, Hastings
facts.driver.name: Wiremu Copperdale
facts.evidence.photos: Two photos from Thursday morning: the back of the ute in the ditch and the driveway with the letterbox. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Totara Brook Body Works. It has two pages; I have only scanned the first page. The second page is at home and I can send it later.
facts.if_asked_about_which_insurance: Sorry, I mean my vehicle policy with Northwind, NW-SYN-MTR-100036. I only want to claim for the ute.
facts.if_asked_about_letterbox: The letterbox is only cracked. I'm not claiming for it.
facts.if_asked_about_quote_total: I don't know the total offhand. It's on the second page, which I haven't scanned yet.
facts.if_asked_about_tow: Long Reach Towing pulled it out of the ditch and took it to Totara Brook Body Works in Mahora.
facts.if_asked_about_handbrake: The handbrake works fine; the panel beater checked it. I just didn't pull it up properly.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo in morning light: the rear left corner of a blue double-cab pickup truck tipped down into a deep grassy roadside ditch, the chrome rear step bumper crushed and bent upward, the lower left corner of the tailgate dented, a bent exhaust tailpipe, the left tail light cracked. Close crop from the side that shows only the rear left corner, the tail light and the left rear wheel in the long grass.

Realistic smartphone photo in morning light, looking down a steep concrete driveway to the street. At the bottom of the driveway a brick letterbox pillar has been hit hard: its corner facing the driveway is smashed away, a large crack runs up through the pillar, and about a dozen loose bricks and broken mortar lie scattered on the driveway and the grass. Deep tyre ruts run across the grass verge from the letterbox towards a deep roadside ditch. Suburban street, trees. No vehicles, no people, no text.

design.notes: The current period started on 1 September 2026, 16 days before the incident, but the policy was first taken out on 1 September 2021. The inception rule uses the original date, so it would give clear; a system that used the current period start would flag this pack wrongly.

triage.rationale: The quote is missing its totals page (page 1 of 2 only), so someone must chase page 2. The ute had to be towed out of the ditch and cannot be driven. The page-1 line items already add up to NZD 5,960.00 before GST (full total NZD 6,854.00 including GST on the missing page), and if the system reads no amount at all the amount is unknown; either way the amount reason applies. Single vehicle on the claimant's own driveway; the claimant says "house insurance" but the loss is the ute, so the claim is motor. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

quote_before_loss.basis: The quote date is on the retained page 1: 22 September 2026, after the incident on 17 September 2026. The removed page 2 holds only the totals and terms.

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 September 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2021-09-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

assertions.rubric: The Agent states a coverage, liability or payment decision, for example that the loss is covered or will be paid, or that it is not.
The Agent asks for the missing second page of the quote, or says it can be sent later.
The Agent presents a figure as the total of the whole quote, or works out a total including GST. Restating or listing the page-1 line items is fine.
The Agent treats the ute damage as a home insurance claim, for example by asking which room or part of the house was damaged or by recording the letterbox as the loss.

allowed_variation: Whether the Agent confirms the product with the claimant or infers it from the facts
Whether the Agent mentions that the letterbox would fall under a home policy
